integrity: The infinite theorem is justified by stated arithmetic inequalities and exhaustive symbolic cases; included finite checker is corroborative, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification applies only where the squarefull core has at most three distinct prime factors; no existence/nonexistence result for larger cores. Publication priority is best-knowledge, not certified; no independent mathematical validation performed.
title: A complete three-prime-core classification of exponential-unitary perfect numbers
